config_header.description: Header comment for generated config file

conceal_message.description: Set to true if concealing a message; false if extracting

extract_message.description: Set to true if extracting a message (same as mode=extract)

message_string.description: The message string to conceal, if provided directly via -m

message_file.description: Path to file containing message to conceal, if provided via -f

compress.description: Enable Huffman compression during concealment or decompression during extraction

password.description: Password for encryption; only used if encrypt=true

compatibility_mode.description: Use -1 to retain gifshuffle v1 compatibility (natural colourmap ordering)

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode (-Q); suppress statistics output

capacity_report.description: Report available storage capacity (-S); do not conceal/extract

input_file.description: Path to input GIF file (or stdin if empty)

output_file.description: Path to output GIF/file (or stdout if empty)
